title: LTB-REMEDIATE-P2 proof follow-up: durable regression proof for the NeckGCodeGenerator boundary
intent: After #400 merged at 36544a3a, close the eight accepted proof gaps. This adds tests only. It does not change production behavior, qualify NeckGCodeGenerator, or contain CF-4.

diff_articulation.what_changed: test_p2_neck_gcode_proof.py adds AST-first gate checks with a misordered-handler negative control, a JSON and attachment program detector with G0/G1/M3 and prose/escaped-newline controls, a five-route neck census that fails when empty, missing, or extended, a handler-to-implementation-to-key inventory that fails when two implementations share a key, a schema-invalid request that documents the FastAPI/Pydantic boundary, and a negative control that the emitting 200 assertion fails without the test-only gate lift. test_p2_neck_gcode_generator_containment.py renames and rewrites the semantic-parsing test description so it no longer claims the gate precedes FastAPI validation.
diff_articulation.why: The #400 review accepted these eight items as proof gaps, not production defects. They are closed on the immutable merge SHA 36544a3a2b3a679b02b0865865e69c78420f5987.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The P-2 containment suite shows refusal and a line-start G/M regex. It does not prove the gate is the first executable statement, does not read program fields out of escaped JSON, and does not map the five neck handlers to distinct implementations.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No production file. No readiness record. No route. No gate placement. CF-4 (#401), CF-3 logging, qualification, delegation structure, GET catalogs, implementation consolidation, and P-3 are untouched.
diff_articulation.why_structural_extraction: Not an extraction. Test proof only.

commands_run: Base is origin/main 36544a3a2b3a679b02b0865865e69c78420f5987, the merge of #400. Merge-base equals that SHA.
AST re-check on that SHA: generate_neck_gcode and download_neck_gcode still open on _readiness_gate('neck_gcode_generator'). No production edit followed.

cd services/api && python -m pytest tests/test_p2_neck_gcode_proof.py tests/test_p2_neck_gcode_generator_containment.py tests/test_neck_gcode_smoke.py tests/test_generator_readiness.py tests/test_generator_readiness_routes.py tests/test_p1_neck_pipeline_containment.py tests/test_p1_neck_pipeline_motion.py -q --no-cov -> 110 passed.
proofs: first_statement_gate_key returns None for a handler that delegates before the gate, and returns neck_gcode_generator when the gate is the first executable statement.
program_records reads G0, G1, and M3 from escaped JSON and from attachment bytes, and returns none from reason, evidence, detail, message, and exit_condition.
The live census equals the five declared neck program routes in both the routing graph and OpenAPI, and fails on an added, missing, or empty set.
The identity map is generate/download -> NeckGCodeGenerator -> neck_gcode_generator, inline guitar neck -> neck, NeckPipeline routes -> neck_pipeline_full. A shared-key fixture fails.
POST /api/neck/gcode/generate with scale_length as a string is a Pydantic 422, not GENERATOR_READINESS_BLOCKED. Unknown style strings that Pydantic accepts still hit the readiness gate.
verification.hardware: No physical-machine execution. No generated program was sent to a machine.

files.intent: Close the eight accepted P-2 proof gaps.
State that the existing semantic-parsing test is in-handler parsing, after FastAPI has admitted the body.
files.behavior_change: None. Docstring and test name only. The request body and assertions are unchanged.

findings: LOW: proof-only tests. Production handlers were re-read on 36544a3a and not modified.
